text:
taylor: quick idea: use registry overlays + a staggered revoke workflow to avoid eviction storms when we unpin hot shards. keep bundles minimal.

mina: love the overlay approach. how do we ensure revoke doesn't trigger mass evictions and OOMs?

ash: add revoke_grace_ms and revoke_rate_limit in overlay. loader should honor revoke_grace_ms to drain requests and apply a token-bucket eviction cadence.

omar: also need a dry-run apply so perf-sim can estimate memory delta before applying. overlay schema: {overlay_uuid, ops:[{shard,op,priority}], revoke_grace_ms, rollout_rate}.

taylor: agree on dry-run. registry should return an overlay_score computed from historical hotness so we can gate high-risk overlays.

mina: telemetry: overlay_apply_latency, overlay_revoke_churn, overlay_eviction_pace, percent_requests_blocked_by_revoke. set alert if overlay_revoke_churn > 0.2% for 10m.

ash: loader API primitive: apply_overlay(overlay_id, mode="dry-run|apply|apply-staggered") and ensure_shard(shard_uuid, opts). also expose ensure_shard(..., strategy="sync|background|prefetch")

taylor: fallback behavior on cold shard: block-with-timeout, serve-compat-model, or error+retry. recommend default = serve-compat-model for user experience.

mina: compatibility: overlays must include manifest_version and be signed. loader rejects overlays with mismatched manifest_version. add overlay_audit field (user/why).

warmup-bot: perf-sim for overlay=hot-200 (bundle=large-x-2, mode=dry-run) complete: estimated mem -8%, median cold +20ms, 95p +280ms. report: https://ci.example/reports/4319999999

ash: next: PoC loader patch to accept overlays behind flag + a perf-sim integration for revoke scenarios. who wants the staging ticket?

omar: i'll take staging ticket and wire dry-run + apply-staggered.

taylor: thanks, Omar. will draft overlay proto and sign flow.

mina: i'll add dashboard panels and an alert. keep canary per-AZ.

taylor: cool. landing plan: registry PoC -> loader flag -> perf sims -> small AZ canary -> global roll.
